scope: Approved analytical subset of the actual semantic model, not a claim of full model schema
productDisclaimer: Agent365 is a custom demonstration semantic model/report, NOT the Microsoft Agent 365 product or an official product schema.
reuseRequirement: The pattern is reusable with other compatible Power BI semantic models after adapting schema, DAX queries, permissions and configuration. Current templates do not work unchanged with arbitrary models.

Interactions.meaning: Purview-audited Copilot turns; one row per user request across Copilot surfaces

Interaction Sessions.meaning: Distinct conversation threads; returns only a count

Interaction Users.meaning: Distinct people using any Copilot surface in the selected period; count only

Agent.AgentKey: Text: unique environment ID plus agent ID

knownBrokenMeasures.Agent Interactions: Text/Boolean comparison error observed; model not modified

privacy: Aggregate counts and agent labels/keys only. No owner/user identities, session IDs, messages or transcripts.
dateSemantics: Date filters are inclusive audit-date filters. Inventory counts are current snapshot counts; historical inventory analytics are not implemented.
usageCaveat: All-surface totals include base Copilot and unlinked events. An Agent grouping/filter uses the active AgentKey relationship. Missing telemetry does not mean an agent was unused.
